world.text: Having deserted the Ottoman army, Skanderbeg arrived in the Albanian city of Krujë and, using a forged letter from Sultan Murad II to the governor of Krujë, became lord of the city.
Natchez Indians revolted against French colonists near modern-day Natchez, Mississippi, killing approximately 230 people.
At the All-Albanian Congress, the Assembly of Vlorë was constituted, which declared the independence of the Albanian Vilayet from the Ottoman Empire.
Wasfi Tal, Prime Minister of Jordan, was assassinated in Cairo by gunmen from the Black September Organization.
South African Airways Flight 295 suffered a catastrophic in-flight fire and crashed into the Indian Ocean east of Mauritius, killing all 159 people on board.
